name: Tight Hardcore
notes: Use: fast hardcore and metallic hardcore with chugs. RUETZ removes the low-frequency gain leg and TIGHT 4 cuts the sub, so the low end stays clear at high gain. Into a cranked British amp (TONE3000 86089), V30-style cab (45023). Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
